title: Basic Calculator II
description: Given a valid arithmetic expression string `s` containing non-negative integers, the operators `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, and optional spaces, evaluate and return its integer value. Multiplication and division have higher precedence than addition and subtraction, and integer division truncates toward zero.
constraints: s consists of digits, '+', '-', '*', '/', and spaces.
All intermediate results and the final answer fit in a 32-bit signed integer; division by zero never occurs.
hints: Process left to right remembering the previous operator and the last evaluated term.
For '+' or '-', add the last term to the running total and start a new term; for '*' or '/', update the last term in place using truncation toward zero.
